title: Two Seymour vertices in every sink-free oriented graph
description: Every nonempty finite sink-free oriented graph has two distinct vertices whose exact second out-neighborhood cardinality is at least the first. Proof relative to two explicitly stipulated OpenAI inputs at the pinned revision. Known Dara et al. Conjecture 2; exceptional-boundary and aggregate-fiber argument. Full graph theorem not formalized; precise supporting coverage is recorded in the package.
notes: Original code has a separate MIT license. No external submission, publication, DOI reservation or peer-review acceptance is claimed. Destination account details and final review approval are outstanding.
